Reddit: Financial Services dropped -12.5 to 51.1 (-11.2 on the week, mentions -62%, sentiment 0.27; FBALX, FSKAX), and Utilities -6.5 to 70.4 (+2.8 on the week, mentions -46%, sentiment 0.08; NEE, RWE, AEP).

ASAN (#1): a preview expects higher Q3 revenue and another piece calls the stock below fair value; with earnings on 12-01, this partly explains the attention.
LYFT (#2): headlines are about Uber's bookings and a fund raising its Lyft stake; they do not clearly explain the ranking.
IOT (#5): articles on a stock list and on Samsara's four profitable quarters, ahead of 12-03 earnings; a partial explanation.
AEO (#7): Black Friday retail spending and a Q3 earnings preview (report 12-02) fit the higher attention.
MO (#8): Altria confirmed it is considering an offer for Imperial Brands, likely all cash; a plausible driver of its attention.
PINS (#10): items on a Reddit price target and Pinterest breaking its 50-day average; only a weak explanation.
RBLX (#11): a list of entertainment stocks and a piece on Nvidia's losses; neither explains the ranking.
DLTR (#12): a downgrade to hold and a report of a 3% stock fall; it slipped from #4 to #12.

ASAN is #1 (score 0.919, up from #384): attention and attention on X are above about 98% of scored topics, open interest above 94% and volume above 82%, while its price move ranks at 67%; earnings on 12-01 are the listed catalyst. LYFT is #2 (0.906, from #5): volume (97th percentile), price move (93rd, +5.3% in 24h) and attention (93rd) are all high, with attention on X at the 88th and no catalyst listed. BUD is #3 (0.904, from #13): attention (96th percentile), volume (96th) and attention on X (94th) carry it, with a more moderate price move (76th, -1.9%) and no catalyst or matched news. The catalyst label is shown for context; it is not one of the weighted inputs in the score.
